context: A teacher helps a teen prep for an essay competition
purpose: Teach: 学長/医学部/皇室/動詞/交響曲/結晶/法科/欠如

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 作文コンクール、テーマは決まった？去年は皇室の歴史で書いた子が入賞したのよ。
lines.en: Have you decided on your essay theme? Last year a student who wrote about the Imperial Household's history won a prize.
lines.style: Warm encouraging teacher voice, mid-pitch, gentle and inviting tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うーん、まだ迷ってて…私、将来は医学部に行きたいから、医療現場のことを書こうかなって。
lines.en: Hmm, I'm still undecided. Since I want to go to med school, maybe I'll write about life in medical workplaces.
lines.style: Hesitant teen voice, slightly higher pitch, thoughtful and a bit uncertain.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいテーマね。実はうちの学長も、若い頃は法科を目指してから医学に進んだ人なの。話を聞いてみたら？
lines.en: Nice theme. Actually our principal originally aimed for law school before switching to medicine. Why not ask him about it?
lines.style: Bright supportive teacher tone, encouraging warmth, slightly elevated pitch.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、そうなんですか！でも書き出しが難しくて…同じ動詞ばっかり使っちゃって、語彙が欠如してる気がします。
lines.en: Wow, really? But the opening is hard. I keep using the same verbs, and I feel my vocabulary is lacking.
lines.style: Surprised then frustrated teen voice, slight whiny edge, self-critical tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、誰でも最初はそうよ。いい文章はね、何度も書き直した努力の結晶なの。
lines.en: Heh, everyone starts that way. A good piece of writing is the crystallization of repeated rewrites.
lines.style: Gentle reassuring teacher voice, steady pace, motherly warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生は集中したい時、どうやって書いてるんですか？
lines.en: Sensei, how do you write when you want to focus?
lines.style: Curious teen voice, slightly brighter and more engaged, leaning in.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 私はね、交響曲を小さく流しながら書くのが昔からの癖なの。気持ちが落ち着くわよ。
lines.en: I have an old habit of writing with a symphony playing softly in the background. It calms the mind.
lines.style: Nostalgic gentle teacher tone, reflective and personal, soft delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 素敵！じゃあ私も今夜、何か聴きながら書いてみます。先生、ありがとうございます！
lines.en: How lovely! Then tonight I'll try writing while listening to something too. Thank you, sensei!
lines.style: Brightening hopeful teen voice, energetic and grateful, lifted final note.
